top_choice_rationale: P001 rewards a specific, mature and independently reproduced achievement: the magic-wavelength optical lattice clock, confirmed at the 10^-18 level by agreeing laboratories in several countries. The two-name allocation (Katori, Ye) is the cleanest on the shortlist, and a citation naming the magic-wavelength lattice separates it from the 2005 comb and 2012 ion-control prizes. Reservations about prospective fundamental-physics payoffs and incomplete credit to Lemonde, Takamoto and Derevianko are real, but they do not outweigh awarding a well-verified discovery over no award.
